scripts.setup: npm install && npm run fonts && npm run doctor
scripts.fix: npm run --workspace=@elongo/viewer fix && npm run --workspace=@elongo/correspondent fix
scripts.clean: rm -rf apps/*/ios apps/*/android apps/*/.expo && echo 'Native directories removed. Re-run npm run ios / npm run android.'
scripts.pods: cd apps/viewer/ios && RCT_USE_RN_DEP=0 RCT_USE_PREBUILT_RNCORE=0 USE_HERMES=1 pod install
